title: ALN Game Pack Strings (strings.json)
description: Pack-declared display strings (Phase 3 A3 slice 3a; design: docs/plans/2026-08-21-phase3-a3-slice3a-strings.md in ALN-Ecosystem). game.json's `strings` field names this sidecar file; the manifest builder assigns it the `strings` role. Content is namespaced sections of LEAF STRING values (sections nest — e.g. strings.scanner.statLabels.score). The section vocabulary is deliberately OPEN (schema-open, gate-enforced house rule): consumers fall back to their baked defaults for any key a pack omits — missing strings are benign wording, never wrong scoring — while a DECLARED strings file that is missing or malformed refuses activation loudly (declared ⇒ must load).
